pie:
Myths on Clay tells the Egyptian myths in the style of ancient tomb paintings and papyrus scrolls, one story at a time, in the order the Egyptians told them.
Sources: the Pyramid Texts, the Coffin Texts, the Book of the Dead, the Book of the Heavenly Cow, the Contendings of Horus and Seth, Plutarch's On Isis and Osiris.
Narrated by Matías.
